name: broadcastforge-studio
description: Local-first real-time sports broadcast graphics: import a scorebug, make it live, animate it, and drive it in OBS Studio.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @bf/web && npm run build -w @bf/server
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared --noEmit && tsc -p packages/server --noEmit && tsc -p packages/web --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test
